start: 1-1 level_start savestate -- Mario spawns at x=40; there is no x=0

terminator.note: terminator effectively off; the frame cap is the only bound

disk_scan.note: both start at x=40 and both were MISLABELLED by the terminator; traces record no world/stage, which is why the script arm is re-run here

terminator_recommendation.rationale: set above the OBSERVED MAXIMUM recovered freeze; a terminator only has to outlast freezes an episode can come back from. A first guess of 1800 was below the measured p99.9 and was discarded -- the number is measured, not chosen

verdict: **1-1 IS COMPLETABLE FROM THE LEVEL START — AND A COIN-FLIPPING SCRIPT DOES IT.** From x=40 with the terminator off, the fixed-rate script (A 0.85 / Left 0.135 / Down 0.086) grabs the flagpole on 1 of 200 episodes and completes the level (1 stage advances to 1-2); the learned policy P_84_cnn32_seed4 at T=0.7 grabs it on 4 of 200 and completes 4. **So a completion is a milestone for the project and NOT evidence of learned skill** — the honest sentence has to carry both halves. Two such completions were already sitting on disk mislabelled `stuck` and `budget`. Recovered-freeze p99.9 = 5374 frames, so stall=6500 clears it (a first guess of 1800 did NOT -- discarded), and stall=300 was censoring a fifth to a half of all episodes.
